desc: Prove the geometric visibility criterion using slopes and determine whether top endpoints alone are sufficient.
Derive the exact formula for the minimum observer height needed for a particular building to become visible past all earlier buildings.

Develop and prove an \(O(N)\) monotone convex-hull algorithm that computes the maximum rational blocking threshold exactly (or with safe long-double output), including strict-equality and the height-0 \(-1\) case; then provide the complete Python implementation.
Analyze strict versus non-strict inequalities to correctly handle heights where sight lines intersect building endpoints.
Produce a robust implementation plan using floating point or exact rational comparisons, including output precision requirements.
